"""CMLD network diagram -> DXF (zigzag grid, compact spacing).

Spacing is computed from label widths measured the way the user's AutoCAD draws them (metrics.py): columns are
only as far apart as the widest label (plus a gap), rows only as far apart as the tallest label stack, and the
wrap-around cable at the edge hugs the end column. The tube / core / type labels of every cable are packed tightly
against the line; vertical cables use the same three-line stack as horizontal ones (not rotated).
"""
import math
import re

import ezdxf
from ezdxf.enums import TextEntityAlignment

from .metrics import mtext_height, text_width


def build_dxf(rows, OUTPUT_DXF_PATH, KODE_PROYEK, NAMA_PROYEK, GRID_COLS=5):
    rows = [r[:5] for r in rows]
    GRID_COLS = int(GRID_COLS)
    if GRID_COLS < 1:
        raise ValueError("Jumlah perangkat per baris minimal 1")
    N = len(rows)
    COLS = GRID_COLS


    def clean_name(device, keep_suffix=True):
        base = re.sub(r'\s*\([^)]*\)\s*$', '', device).strip()
        suffix_m = re.search(r'(\([^)]*\)\s*)$', device)
        suffix = suffix_m.group(1).strip() if (suffix_m and keep_suffix) else ''
        return f"{base} {suffix}".strip() if suffix else base


    def extract_type(cable_out):
        m = re.match(r'CABLE\s+(.*?),?\s*TUBE:\s*(.*?)\s*CORE\s*:\s*(.*)', cable_out, re.IGNORECASE)
        if not m:
            return None, None, None
        return m.group(1).strip(), m.group(2).strip().rstrip(',').strip(), m.group(3).strip()


    # --- fixed design values (text heights and symbol sizes are the approved ones) ------------------
    DIAG_LEFT = 20
    DIAG_TOP = 20
    SYM = 10
    TRI = 16
    H_TUBE, H_CORE, H_TYPE = 4.0, 3.6, 4.8
    H_NAME, H_STREET, H_COORD = 4.8, 4.0, 3.4
    GAP = 16          # minimum clear space between neighbouring labels (the width model already adds ~8 % safety)
    MIN_COL = 100     # never closer than this between devices
    BOX = 1.28        # TEXT bounding-box height / text height (measured with ezdxf)
    STACK_GAP = 3.0   # clear space between the tube / core / type lines above a cable
    TYPE_BOTTOM = 4.0 # clear space between the cable line and the type label
    BELOW = 37        # lowest label under a device (symbol + name + street + coordinates)
    ROW_CLEAR = 24    # clear space between the label stack of one row and the devices' labels above it
    LINE_GAP = 8      # clear space between a vertical (wrap-around) cable and its label stack

    # --- measure the labels with the AutoCAD-calibrated model (dxf_metrics.py) --------------------------
    tw = text_width
    mt_height = mtext_height


    dev_labels = []
    for i, (device, street, lat, lon, cable_out) in enumerate(rows):
        dev_labels.append((f"{i + 1}). {clean_name(device, keep_suffix=(i != 0))}", street, f"{lat:.6f}, {lon:.6f}"))

    segs = [extract_type(rows[i][4]) for i in range(N - 1)]
    same_row = [(i // COLS) == ((i + 1) // COLS) for i in range(N - 1)]

    dev_w = [max(tw(n, H_NAME), tw(s, H_STREET), tw(c, H_COORD)) for n, s, c in dev_labels]


    def tube_lines(tube, limit):
        """Lines of the '(tube)' label. A label wider than `limit` that holds several tube groups is split between the
        groups, e.g. '((RED (LAYER 2)),(AQUA(LAYER 2)))' -> '((RED (LAYER 2)),' / '(AQUA(LAYER 2)))'."""
        label = f"({tube})"
        groups = re.split(r"(?<=\)),(?=\()", tube)
        if tw(label, H_TUBE) <= limit or len(groups) < 2:
            return [label]
        lines, cur = [], ""
        for k, g in enumerate(groups):
            piece = g + ("," if k < len(groups) - 1 else "")
            prefix = "(" if not lines else ""
            suffix = ")" if k == len(groups) - 1 else ""
            if cur and tw(prefix + cur + piece + suffix, H_TUBE) > limit:
                lines.append(prefix + cur)
                cur = piece
            else:
                cur += piece
        lines.append(("(" if not lines else "") + cur + ")")
        return lines


    TUBE_LIMIT = max(dev_w)                    # a tube label never needs to be wider than the widest device label
    tlines = [tube_lines(tube, TUBE_LIMIT) if ctype else [] for ctype, tube, core in segs]
    seg_w = [max(max(tw(l, H_TUBE) for l in tlines[i]), tw(ctype, H_TYPE)) for i, (ctype, tube, core) in enumerate(segs) if ctype]

    COL_W = max(MIN_COL, math.ceil(max(dev_w + seg_w) + GAP))
    WRAP_W = COL_W - GAP                       # width of the (wrapping) core list
    END_CAP = COL_W - 2 * (TRI + 1.2) - 6      # narrower for the first/last cable so the text clears the endpoint circle


    def wrap_w_for(i):
        return min(WRAP_W, END_CAP) if (i == 0 or i + 1 == N - 1) else WRAP_W


    H_OFF = max(TRI + 12, math.ceil(max(dev_w) / 2 + 12))   # wrap-around cable sits just outside the end column

    # Label stack of every cable, packed tightly: tube on top, core list (wraps) in the middle, type nearest the line.
    #  - horizontal cables: the stack sits above the line (distances measured from the line)
    #  - vertical (wrap-around) cables: the same stack, NOT rotated, sits beside the line on the outer side and is
    #    centred on the middle of the cable (every line centred on the widest line of the stack)
    stack = [None] * (N - 1)       # horizontal: (type_c, core_top, tube_cs, stack_top), measured from the cable line
    vstack = [None] * (N - 1)      # vertical:   (width, type_c, core_top, tube_cs, height), measured from the stack's bottom
    v_w_max = 0.0
    v_h_max = 0.0
    bh_type, bh_tube = H_TYPE * BOX, H_TUBE * BOX


    def layout_stack(tl, core, core_w, base):
        """Centres of the type label and of every tube line, and the top of the core block, measured from `base`
        (the line for horizontal cables, the bottom of the block for vertical ones). Also returns the stack's top."""
        type_c = base + bh_type / 2
        core_top = base + bh_type + STACK_GAP + mt_height(core, H_CORE, core_w) + 1.0   # +1.0 = MTEXT box margin below its last line
        n = len(tl)
        tube_bottom = core_top + STACK_GAP
        tube_cs = [tube_bottom + (n - 1 - k) * (bh_tube + 1.0) + bh_tube / 2 for k in range(n)]   # k = 0 is the top line
        return type_c, core_top, tube_cs, tube_bottom + n * bh_tube + (n - 1) * 1.0


    for i, (ctype, tube, core) in enumerate(segs):
        if not ctype:
            continue
        if same_row[i]:
            stack[i] = layout_stack(tlines[i], core, wrap_w_for(i), TYPE_BOTTOM)          # (type_c, core_top, tube_cs, top)
        else:
            W = math.ceil(max(max(tw(l, H_TUBE) for l in tlines[i]), tw(ctype, H_TYPE), min(tw(core, H_CORE), WRAP_W))) + 4
            vstack[i] = (W,) + layout_stack(tlines[i], core, W, 0)                            # (W, type_c, core_top, tube_cs, height)
            v_w_max = max(v_w_max, W)
            v_h_max = max(v_h_max, vstack[i][4])

    top_max = max([st[3] for st in stack if st] + [0.0])
    ROW_H = max(math.ceil(BELOW + top_max + ROW_CLEAR), math.ceil((v_h_max + 20) / 2))


    def row_y(r):
        return -(DIAG_TOP + r * ROW_H)


    def col_x(r, c):
        if r % 2 == 0:
            return DIAG_LEFT + c * COL_W
        return DIAG_LEFT + (COLS - 1 - c) * COL_W


    positions = []
    for i in range(N):
        r = i // COLS
        c = i % COLS
        positions.append((col_x(r, c), row_y(r)))

    doc = ezdxf.new(dxfversion="R2010")
    doc.units = ezdxf.units.MM
    msp = doc.modelspace()

    doc.layers.add(name="CLOSURES", color=7)
    doc.layers.add(name="LINES", color=7)
    doc.layers.add(name="LABELS", color=5)
    doc.layers.add(name="CABLE_SPEC", color=5)
    doc.layers.add(name="ENDPOINTS", color=1)
    doc.layers.add(name="TITLEBLOCK", color=7)


    def add_text(msp, text, pos, height=1.6, layer="LABELS", align=TextEntityAlignment.MIDDLE_CENTER):
        t = msp.add_text(text, dxfattribs={"layer": layer, "height": height})
        t.set_placement(pos, align=align)


    EDGE_RIGHT = DIAG_LEFT + (COLS - 1) * COL_W + H_OFF
    EDGE_LEFT = DIAG_LEFT - H_OFF

    # --- cable segments -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    for i in range(N - 1):
        x1, y1 = positions[i]
        x2, y2 = positions[i + 1]
        ctype, tube, core = segs[i]

        if same_row[i]:
            msp.add_line((x1, y1), (x2, y2), dxfattribs={"layer": "LINES"})
            mx, my = (x1 + x2) / 2, y1
            if ctype:
                type_c, core_top, tube_cs, _ = stack[i]
                for line, yc in zip(tlines[i], tube_cs):
                    add_text(msp, line, (mx, my + yc), height=H_TUBE, layer="CABLE_SPEC")
                mtext = msp.add_mtext(core, dxfattribs={"layer": "CABLE_SPEC", "char_height": H_CORE, "attachment_point": 2})
                mtext.set_location((mx, my + core_top))
                mtext.dxf.width = wrap_w_for(i)
                add_text(msp, ctype, (mx, my + type_c), height=H_TYPE, layer="CABLE_SPEC")
        else:
            r_a = i // COLS
            edge_x = EDGE_RIGHT if r_a % 2 == 0 else EDGE_LEFT
            msp.add_lwpolyline([(x1, y1), (edge_x, y1), (edge_x, y2), (x2, y2)], dxfattribs={"layer": "LINES"})
            if ctype:
                W, type_c, core_top, tube_cs, Hs = vstack[i]
                right = (r_a % 2 == 0)
                cx = edge_x + (LINE_GAP + W / 2) * (1 if right else -1)   # stack sits just outside the vertical cable
                ybot = (y1 + y2) / 2 - Hs / 2                             # ... centred on the middle of it
                for line, yc in zip(tlines[i], tube_cs):
                    add_text(msp, line, (cx, ybot + yc), height=H_TUBE, layer="CABLE_SPEC")
                vmt = msp.add_mtext(core, dxfattribs={"layer": "CABLE_SPEC", "char_height": H_CORE, "attachment_point": 2})
                vmt.set_location((cx, ybot + core_top))
                vmt.dxf.width = W
                add_text(msp, ctype, (cx, ybot + type_c), height=H_TYPE, layer="CABLE_SPEC")

    # --- devices ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    for i, (device, street, lat, lon, cable_out) in enumerate(rows):
        x, y = positions[i]
        is_endpoint = (i == 0 or i == N - 1)

        if is_endpoint:
            msp.add_circle((x, y), TRI + 1.2, dxfattribs={"layer": "ENDPOINTS"})
            pts = [(x, y + TRI), (x - TRI * 0.87, y - TRI * 0.6), (x + TRI * 0.87, y - TRI * 0.6)]
            hatch = msp.add_hatch(color=1, dxfattribs={"layer": "ENDPOINTS"})
            hatch.paths.add_polyline_path(pts, is_closed=True)
            msp.add_lwpolyline(pts + [pts[0]], dxfattribs={"layer": "ENDPOINTS"})
        else:
            left_tri = [(x - SYM, y + SYM), (x - SYM, y - SYM), (x, y)]
            right_tri = [(x + SYM, y + SYM), (x + SYM, y - SYM), (x, y)]
            msp.add_lwpolyline(left_tri + [left_tri[0]], dxfattribs={"layer": "CLOSURES"})
            msp.add_lwpolyline(right_tri + [right_tri[0]], dxfattribs={"layer": "CLOSURES"})

        name_label, street_label, coord_label = dev_labels[i]
        label_below_y = y - (TRI + 5 if is_endpoint else SYM + 4)
        add_text(msp, name_label, (x, label_below_y), height=H_NAME, layer="LABELS")
        add_text(msp, street_label, (x, label_below_y - 7.0), height=H_STREET, layer="LABELS")
        add_text(msp, coord_label, (x, label_below_y - 13.0), height=H_COORD, layer="LABELS")

    # --- title block (kept clear of the wrap-around cable text) --------------------------------------
    tb_x = EDGE_RIGHT + max(48, LINE_GAP + math.ceil(v_w_max) + 24)
    tb_y = 10
    title_lines = [
        "PT. SOLUSI MITRA TAMA", "AS BUILT DRAWING", "",
        f"Kode Proyek: {KODE_PROYEK}",
        f"Nama Proyek: {NAMA_PROYEK}",
        f"Jumlah Titik: {N}", "Skala: N.T.S", "Halaman: 1 OF 1",
    ]
    for k, line in enumerate(title_lines):
        add_text(msp, line, (tb_x, tb_y - k * 4), height=2.2 if k == 0 else 1.8,
                 layer="TITLEBLOCK", align=TextEntityAlignment.TOP_LEFT)

    doc.saveas(OUTPUT_DXF_PATH)
    return f"DXF: {N} perangkat, {GRID_COLS} per baris, COL_W={COL_W} ROW_H={ROW_H}"
cmld/gui.py:
"""Tkinter window: pick input, fill project names, tick outputs, click Buat."""
import os
import re
import queue
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import traceback
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk

from .pipeline import Job, default_schema, run

FOLDER_PRESETS = ["AGG / OLT  (backbone)", "OLT / FDT  (feeder)", "OLT / HUB BOX  (feeder)"]


def open_path(path):
    try:
        if sys.platform.startswith("win"):
            os.startfile(path)
        elif sys.platform == "darwin":
            subprocess.Popen(["open", path])
        else:
            subprocess.Popen(["xdg-open", path])
    except Exception:
        pass


class App(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("CMLD - Excel / KMZ / DXF jaringan FTTH")
        self.minsize(720, 600)
        self.q = queue.Queue()
        self.v = {k: tk.StringVar() for k in
                  ("input", "out_dir", "base", "kmz_project", "kmz_schema", "first", "last", "kode", "nama")}
        self.cols = tk.IntVar(value=5)
        self.chk = {k: tk.BooleanVar(value=d) for k, d in
                    (("xlsx", True), ("kmz", True), ("dxf", True), ("preview", True), ("json", False))}
        self.v["first"].set("AGG")
        self.v["last"].set("OLT")
        self._build()
        self.after(100, self._poll)

    # --- layout ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build(self):
        pad = {"padx": 6, "pady": 3}
        f = ttk.Frame(self, padding=10)
        f.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        f.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)
        r = 0

        def row(label, var, button=None, cmd=None, hint=None):
            nonlocal r
            ttk.Label(f, text=label).grid(row=r, column=0, sticky="w", **pad)
            ttk.Entry(f, textvariable=var).grid(row=r, column=1, sticky="ew", **pad)
            if button:
                ttk.Button(f, text=button, command=cmd).grid(row=r, column=2, sticky="ew", **pad)
            elif hint:
                ttk.Label(f, text=hint, foreground="#777").grid(row=r, column=2, sticky="w", **pad)
            r += 1

        def section(text):
            nonlocal r
            ttk.Label(f, text=text, font=("Segoe UI", 10, "bold")).grid(row=r, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="w", pady=(10, 2))
            r += 1

        section("1. Data")
        row("File input (.xlsx / .json)", self.v["input"], "Pilih...", self.pick_input)
        row("Folder hasil", self.v["out_dir"], "Pilih...", self.pick_out)
        row("Nama proyek & file hasil", self.v["base"], hint="dipakai di file, KMZ, DXF")

        section("2. KMZ")
        ttk.Label(f, text="Folder titik pertama / terakhir").grid(row=r, column=0, sticky="w", **pad)
        ff = ttk.Frame(f)
        ff.grid(row=r, column=1, sticky="ew", **pad)
        ttk.Entry(ff, textvariable=self.v["first"], width=12).pack(side="left")
        ttk.Label(ff, text=" / ").pack(side="left")
        ttk.Entry(ff, textvariable=self.v["last"], width=12).pack(side="left")
        preset = ttk.Combobox(f, values=FOLDER_PRESETS, state="readonly", width=24)
        preset.set("Preset...")
        preset.bind("<<ComboboxSelected>>", lambda e: self._preset(preset.get()))
        preset.grid(row=r, column=2, sticky="ew", **pad)
        r += 1

        section("3. DXF")
        ttk.Label(f, text="Perangkat per baris").grid(row=r, column=0, sticky="w", **pad)
        ttk.Spinbox(f, from_=1, to=20, textvariable=self.cols, width=6).grid(row=r, column=1, sticky="w", **pad)
        r += 1

        section("4. Yang dibuat")
        cf = ttk.Frame(f)
        cf.grid(row=r, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="w", **pad)
        for k, label in (("xlsx", "Excel Data Mancore"), ("kmz", "KMZ"), ("dxf", "DXF (+ cek tabrakan)"),
                         ("preview", "Preview PNG"), ("json", "rows JSON")):
            ttk.Checkbutton(cf, text=label, variable=self.chk[k]).pack(side="left", padx=(0, 12))
        r += 1

        bf = ttk.Frame(f)
        bf.grid(row=r, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="ew", pady=(10, 4))
        self.btn = ttk.Button(bf, text="Buat", command=self.start)
        self.btn.pack(side="left")
        ttk.Button(bf, text="Buka folder hasil", command=lambda: open_path(self.v["out_dir"].get() or ".")).pack(side="left", padx=6)
        ttk.Button(bf, text="Template Excel kosong...", command=self.save_template).pack(side="right")
        r += 1

        self.log = tk.Text(f, height=14, wrap="word", font=("Consolas", 9))
        self.log.grid(row=r, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="nsew", **pad)
        f.rowconfigure(r, weight=1)
        self.write("Pilih file input (Excel Data Mancore atau rows JSON), isi nama proyek, lalu klik Buat.")

    def _preset(self, text):
        first, last = [s.strip() for s in text.split("(")[0].split("/")]
        self.v["first"].set(first)
        self.v["last"].set(last)

    # --- actions --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def pick_input(self):
        p = filedialog.askopenfilename(filetypes=[("Excel / JSON", "*.xlsx *.xlsm *.json"), ("Semua file", "*.*")])
        if not p:
            return
        self.v["input"].set(p)
        stem = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(p))[0]
        if not self.v["out_dir"].get():
            self.v["out_dir"].set(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(p), "hasil"))
        if not self.v["base"].get():
            self.v["base"].set(stem)

    def pick_out(self):
        p = filedialog.askdirectory()
        if p:
            self.v["out_dir"].set(p)

    def save_template(self):
        p = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(defaultextension=".xlsx", initialfile="template_input.xlsx",
                                         filetypes=[("Excel", "*.xlsx")])
        if p:
            from .xlsx_out import build_template
            build_template(p)
            self.write(f"Template disimpan: {p}")
            open_path(p)

    def write(self, text):
        self.log.insert("end", text + "\n")
        self.log.see("end")

    def start(self):
        g = {k: v.get().strip() for k, v in self.v.items()}
        if not g["input"] or not os.path.isfile(g["input"]):
            messagebox.showwarning("CMLD", "Pilih file input dulu.")
            return
        if not any(v.get() for v in self.chk.values()):
            messagebox.showwarning("CMLD", "Centang minimal satu hasil.")
            return
        try:
            cols = int(self.cols.get())
        except (tk.TclError, ValueError):
            messagebox.showwarning("CMLD", "Perangkat per baris harus angka.")
            return
        stem = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(g["input"]))[0]
        name = g["base"] or stem
        job = Job(input_path=g["input"], out_dir=g["out_dir"] or os.path.join(os.path.dirname(g["input"]), "hasil"),
                  base_name=re.sub(r'[\\/:*?"<>|]+', "-", name).strip() or "CMLD",
                  kmz_project=re.sub(r"[/$]", "-", name), kmz_schema=default_schema(name),
                  first_folder=g["first"], last_folder=g["last"], kode_proyek=name, nama_proyek=name,
                  grid_cols=cols, make_xlsx=self.chk["xlsx"].get(), make_kmz=self.chk["kmz"].get(),
                  make_dxf=self.chk["dxf"].get(), make_preview=self.chk["preview"].get(),
                  make_json=self.chk["json"].get())
        self.btn.config(state="disabled")
        self.write("\n--- mulai ---")
        threading.Thread(target=self._worker, args=(job,), daemon=True).start()

    def _worker(self, job):
        try:
            files = run(job, log=lambda s: self.q.put(("log", s)))
            self.q.put(("done", files))
        except Exception as e:
            self.q.put(("log", "GAGAL: " + str(e)))
            self.q.put(("log", traceback.format_exc(limit=3)))
            self.q.put(("done", None))

    def _poll(self):
        try:
            while True:
                kind, payload = self.q.get_nowait()
                if kind == "log":
                    self.write(payload)
                else:
                    self.btn.config(state="normal")
                    if payload:
                        png = [p for p in payload if p.endswith(".png")]
                        if png:
                            open_path(png[0])
        except queue.Empty:
            pass
        self.after(100, self._poll)


def main():
    App().mainloop()

"""One run: input file -> chosen outputs. Used by both the GUI and the command line."""
import os
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass

from .core import load_rows, save_json


@dataclass
class Job:
    input_path: str
    out_dir: str
    base_name: str
    kmz_project: str = ""          # KMZ document / popup schema name, e.g. "BB OLT CNT08 to Hub Centenial"
    kmz_schema: str = ""           # e.g. "CNT08_HubCentenial" (letters, digits, _)
    first_folder: str = "AGG"
    last_folder: str = "OLT"
    kode_proyek: str = ""          # DXF title block
    nama_proyek: str = ""          # DXF title block
    grid_cols: int = 5
    make_xlsx: bool = True
    make_kmz: bool = True
    make_dxf: bool = True
    make_preview: bool = True
    make_json: bool = False


def default_schema(text):
    return re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text).strip("_") or "CMLD"


def run(job, log=print):
    """Returns list of written files. Raises on fatal errors; warnings are logged."""
    rows, warnings = load_rows(job.input_path)
    log(f"Input: {os.path.basename(job.input_path)} - {len(rows)} perangkat")
    for w in warnings:
        log("  PERINGATAN: " + w)
    if not warnings:
        log("  Cek data: OK")

    os.makedirs(job.out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    base = os.path.join(job.out_dir, job.base_name)
    written = []

    def same_file(a, b):
        return os.path.abspath(a).lower() == os.path.abspath(b).lower()

    if job.make_xlsx:
        from .xlsx_out import build_xlsx
        p = base + ".xlsx"
        if same_file(p, job.input_path):
            p = base + "_DataMancore.xlsx"
        log(build_xlsx(rows, p))
        written.append(p)

    if job.make_kmz:
        from .kmz_out import build_kmz
        project = job.kmz_project or job.nama_proyek or job.base_name
        schema = job.kmz_schema or default_schema(job.base_name)
        p = base + ".kmz"
        log(build_kmz(rows, p, project, schema, job.first_folder or "AGG", job.last_folder or "OLT"))
        written.append(p)

    if job.make_dxf:
        from .dxf_out import build_dxf
        from .check import check_dxf
        p = base + ".dxf"
        log(build_dxf(rows, p, job.kode_proyek or job.base_name, job.nama_proyek or job.base_name, job.grid_cols))
        written.append(p)
        problems, report = check_dxf(p)
        log("Cek tabrakan DXF: " + ("OK, tidak ada tabrakan" if problems == 0 else f"{problems} tabrakan!"))
        if problems:
            log(report)
        if job.make_preview:
            from .preview import render_preview
            png = base + "_preview.png"
            log(render_preview(p, png))
            written.append(png)

    if job.make_json:
        p = base + ".json"
        save_json(rows, p)
        log(f"JSON: {p}")
        written.append(p)

    if warnings:
        log(f"Ada {len(warnings)} PERINGATAN data - cek daftar di atas sebelum file dikirim.")
    log("Selesai. File di: " + os.path.abspath(job.out_dir))
    return written

"""PNG preview of a DXF with the AutoCAD-calibrated text boxes (what AutoCAD really draws)."""
import ezdxf

from .metrics import mtext_height, text_width

BOXH = 1.3


def render_preview(dxf_path, png_path, width_in=16, height_in=9):
    import matplotlib
    matplotlib.use("Agg")
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

    msp = ezdxf.readfile(dxf_path).modelspace()
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(width_in, height_in), dpi=110)
    ax.set_facecolor("#222831")
    fig.patch.set_facecolor("#222831")
    colour = {"CABLE_SPEC": "#4fc3f7", "LABELS": "#9e9e9e", "TITLEBLOCK": "#bdbdbd"}

    xs, ys = [], []
    for e in msp:
        t, layer = e.dxftype(), e.dxf.layer
        if t == "TEXT" and e.dxf.text.strip():
            h = e.dxf.height
            w = text_width(e.dxf.text, h)
            bh = BOXH * h
            align, p, _ = e.get_placement()
            n = align.name
            x0 = p.x if "LEFT" in n else (p.x - w if "RIGHT" in n else p.x - w / 2)
            y0 = p.y - bh if n.startswith("TOP") else (p.y - bh / 2 if n.startswith("MIDDLE") else p.y)
            c = colour.get(layer, "#4fc3f7")
            ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x0, y0), w, bh, fc=c, alpha=0.45, ec=c, lw=0.4))
            xs += [x0, x0 + w]
            ys += [y0, y0 + bh]
        elif t == "MTEXT":
            w = e.dxf.width
            hh = mtext_height(e.text, e.dxf.char_height, w) + 1.0
            x0, top = e.dxf.insert.x - w / 2, e.dxf.insert.y
            ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x0, top - hh), w, hh, fc="#81c784", alpha=0.45, ec="#81c784", lw=0.4))
            xs += [x0, x0 + w]
            ys += [top - hh, top]
        elif t == "LINE":
            a, b = e.dxf.start, e.dxf.end
            ax.plot([a.x, b.x], [a.y, b.y], color="white", lw=0.8)
        elif t == "LWPOLYLINE":
            pts = [(p[0], p[1]) for p in e.get_points()]
            ax.plot([p[0] for p in pts], [p[1] for p in pts], color="white", lw=0.8 if layer == "LINES" else 0.5)
        elif t == "CIRCLE":
            c = e.dxf.center
            ax.add_patch(plt.Circle((c.x, c.y), e.dxf.radius, fc="none", ec="red", lw=0.8))
    ax.set_aspect("equal")
    ax.set_xlim(min(xs) - 15, max(xs) + 15)
    ax.set_ylim(min(ys) - 15, max(ys) + 15)
    ax.axis("off")
    fig.subplots_adjust(0, 0, 1, 1)
    fig.savefig(png_path, dpi=110)
    plt.close(fig)
    return f"Preview: {png_path}"

"""SVG preview of a DXF made by dxf_out.py. Text is stretched to the AutoCAD-calibrated width (metrics.py),
so spacing looks the way AutoCAD will draw it. No matplotlib needed (works in the browser version too)."""
import html

import ezdxf

from .metrics import LINE_PITCH, text_width, wrap_lines

BOXH = 1.3
COLOURS = {"CABLE_SPEC": "var(--dxf-spec, #2b6cb0)", "LABELS": "var(--dxf-label, #333)",
           "TITLEBLOCK": "var(--dxf-label, #333)", "ENDPOINTS": "var(--dxf-end, #d33)",
           "LINES": "var(--dxf-line, #222)", "CLOSURES": "var(--dxf-line, #222)",
           "HB": "var(--dxf-end, #d33)", "FAT": "var(--dxf-end, #d33)", "KABEL": "var(--dxf-spec, #2b6cb0)",
           "LABEL_PORT": "var(--dxf-label, #333)", "LABEL_FAT": "var(--dxf-label, #333)"}


def render_svg(dxf_path):
    msp = ezdxf.readfile(dxf_path).modelspace()
    out, xs, ys = [], [], []

    def col(layer):
        return COLOURS.get(layer, "var(--dxf-line, #222)")

    def txt(s, x, y_base, h, w, layer, anchor="middle"):
        out.append(f'<text x="{x:.2f}" y="{-y_base:.2f}" font-size="{h:.2f}" text-anchor="{anchor}" '
                   f'textLength="{w:.2f}" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs" fill="{col(layer)}">{html.escape(s)}</text>')

    for e in msp:
        t, layer = e.dxftype(), e.dxf.layer
        if t == "TEXT" and e.dxf.text.strip():
            h = e.dxf.height
            w = text_width(e.dxf.text, h) / 1.08          # drop the safety margin for display
            align, p, _ = e.get_placement()
            n = align.name
            if "LEFT" in n:
                x0, anchor = p.x, "start"
            elif "RIGHT" in n:
                x0, anchor = p.x, "end"
            else:
                x0, anchor = p.x, "middle"
            base = p.y - h if n.startswith("TOP") else (p.y - h / 2 if n.startswith("MIDDLE") else p.y)
            txt(e.dxf.text, x0, base, h, w, layer, anchor)
            left = x0 - (w / 2 if anchor == "middle" else (w if anchor == "end" else 0))
            xs += [left, left + w]
            ys += [base, base + BOXH * h]
        elif t == "MTEXT":
            h, width = e.dxf.char_height, e.dxf.width
            top = e.dxf.insert.y
            for k, line in enumerate(wrap_lines(e.text, h, width)):
                base = top - h - k * h * LINE_PITCH
                txt(line, e.dxf.insert.x, base, h, text_width(line, h) / 1.08, layer)
                ys.append(base)
            xs += [e.dxf.insert.x - width / 2, e.dxf.insert.x + width / 2]
            ys.append(top)
        elif t == "LINE":
            a, b = e.dxf.start, e.dxf.end
            out.append(f'<line x1="{a.x:.2f}" y1="{-a.y:.2f}" x2="{b.x:.2f}" y2="{-b.y:.2f}" stroke="{col(layer)}" stroke-width="0.6"/>')
            xs += [a.x, b.x]
            ys += [a.y, b.y]
        elif t == "LWPOLYLINE":
            pts = [(p[0], p[1]) for p in e.get_points()]
            d = " ".join(f"{x:.2f},{-y:.2f}" for x, y in pts)
            out.append(f'<polyline points="{d}" fill="none" stroke="{col(layer)}" stroke-width="0.6"/>')
            xs += [p[0] for p in pts]
            ys += [p[1] for p in pts]
        elif t == "CIRCLE":
            c, r = e.dxf.center, e.dxf.radius
            out.append(f'<circle cx="{c.x:.2f}" cy="{-c.y:.2f}" r="{r:.2f}" fill="none" stroke="{col(layer)}" stroke-width="0.6"/>')
            xs += [c.x - r, c.x + r]
            ys += [c.y - r, c.y + r]
        elif t == "HATCH":
            for path in e.paths:
                verts = getattr(path, "vertices", None)
                if verts:
                    d = " ".join(f"{v[0]:.2f},{-v[1]:.2f}" for v in verts)
                    out.append(f'<polygon points="{d}" fill="{col(layer)}"/>')

    pad = 10
    x0, x1, y0, y1 = min(xs) - pad, max(xs) + pad, min(ys) - pad, max(ys) + pad
    return (f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="{x0:.1f} {-y1:.1f} {x1 - x0:.1f} {y1 - y0:.1f}" '
            f'font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Preview diagram DXF">'
            + "".join(out) + "</svg>")


def save_svg(dxf_path, svg_path):
    with open(svg_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(render_svg(dxf_path))
    return f"Preview: {svg_path}"

"""Entry point for the browser version (Pyodide). Everything runs in the browser's in-memory filesystem."""
import io
import json
import os
import shutil
import zipfile

from .core import load_rows
from .pipeline import Job, run
from .preview_svg import render_svg

WORK = "/tmp/cmld"


def process(input_bytes, filename, options_json):
    """Returns JSON: {ok, log, rows, warnings, svg, files: {name: bytes}, zip: bytes} (bytes via to_js)."""
    opt = json.loads(options_json)
    shutil.rmtree(WORK, ignore_errors=True)
    os.makedirs(WORK + "/in")
    in_path = os.path.join(WORK, "in", os.path.basename(filename))
    with open(in_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(bytes(input_bytes))

    log = []
    result = {"ok": False, "log": log, "rows": [], "warnings": [], "svg": "", "files": {}, "zip": None}
    try:
        rows, warnings = load_rows(in_path)
        result["rows"] = rows
        result["warnings"] = warnings
        stem = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(filename))[0]
        job = Job(input_path=in_path, out_dir=WORK + "/out", base_name=opt.get("base") or stem,
                  kmz_project=opt.get("kmz_project", ""), kmz_schema=opt.get("kmz_schema", ""),
                  first_folder=opt.get("first") or "AGG", last_folder=opt.get("last") or "OLT",
                  kode_proyek=opt.get("kode", ""), nama_proyek=opt.get("nama", ""),
                  grid_cols=int(opt.get("cols") or 5),
                  make_xlsx=opt.get("xlsx", True), make_kmz=opt.get("kmz", True), make_dxf=True,
                  make_preview=False, make_json=opt.get("json", False))
        written = run(job, log=log.append)
        dxf = [p for p in written if p.endswith(".dxf")][0]
        svg = render_svg(dxf)
        result["svg"] = svg
        if opt.get("svg", True):
            svg_path = os.path.splitext(dxf)[0] + "_preview.svg"
            with open(svg_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(svg)
            written.append(svg_path)
        if not opt.get("dxf", True):
            written.remove(dxf)
        buf = io.BytesIO()
        with zipfile.ZipFile(buf, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
            for p in written:
                z.write(p, os.path.basename(p))
                with open(p, "rb") as f:
                    result["files"][os.path.basename(p)] = f.read()
        result["zip"] = buf.getvalue()
        result["ok"] = True
    except Exception as e:
        log.append("GAGAL: " + str(e))
    return result


def process_hb(input_bytes, filename, options_json):
    """Diagram HB. Returns {ok, log, hub, items, lines, warnings, svg, dxf_name, dxf}."""
    from .hb import build_hb_dxf, load_hb
    opt = json.loads(options_json)
    shutil.rmtree(WORK, ignore_errors=True)
    os.makedirs(WORK + "/in")
    in_path = os.path.join(WORK, "in", os.path.basename(filename))
    with open(in_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(bytes(input_bytes))
    log = []
    res = {"ok": False, "log": log, "hub": "", "items": [], "lines": [], "warnings": [], "svg": "", "dxf_name": "", "dxf": None, "zip": None}
    try:
        hub, lines, items, warnings = load_hb(in_path)
        res.update(hub=hub, items=items, lines=lines, warnings=warnings, splitters=(len(lines) + 1) // 2)
        name = (opt.get("base") or "").strip() or hub
        out = os.path.join(WORK, name + ".dxf")
        log.append(build_hb_dxf(hub, lines, out))
        res["svg"] = render_svg(out)
        with open(out, "rb") as f:
            res["dxf"] = f.read()
        res["dxf_name"] = name + ".dxf"
        buf = io.BytesIO()
        with zipfile.ZipFile(buf, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
            z.write(out, name + ".dxf")
        res["zip"] = buf.getvalue()
        res["ok"] = True
    except Exception as e:
        log.append("GAGAL: " + str(e))
    return res


def hb_template(_bytes=None, _name=None, _opts=None):
    from .hb import build_hb_template
    path = os.path.join("/tmp", "template_hb.xlsx")
    build_hb_template(path)
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        return {"ok": True, "xlsx": f.read()}

"""Data Mancore workbook (Sheet1). CABLE IN is the formula =C{previous row}; rows with a note are highlighted."""
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Alignment, Border, Font, PatternFill, Side

NAVY, STRIPE, WHITE, WARN = "1F3864", "F2F6FA", "FFFFFF", "FFF2CC"
FONT = "Calibri"
HEADERS = ["DEVICE", "CABLE IN", "CABLE OUT", "STREET", "LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE", "MAPS", "CATATAN"]
WIDTHS = {"A": 34, "B": 40, "C": 40, "D": 14, "E": 12, "F": 12, "G": 11, "H": 55}


def build_xlsx(rows, out_path):
    thin = Side(style="thin", color="B7C6D9")
    border = Border(left=thin, right=thin, top=thin, bottom=thin)
    wb = Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "Sheet1"

    for col, h in enumerate(HEADERS, start=1):
        cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col, value=h)
        cell.font = Font(name=FONT, size=11, bold=True, color=WHITE)
        cell.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=NAVY)
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
        cell.border = border

    for i, (device, street, lat, lon, cable_out, note) in enumerate(rows):
        r = i + 2
        fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=WARN if note else (STRIPE if i % 2 == 0 else WHITE))
        cells = [
            ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value=f"{i + 1}).{device}"),
            ws.cell(row=r, column=2, value=("-" if i == 0 else f"=C{r - 1}")),
            ws.cell(row=r, column=3, value=cable_out),
            ws.cell(row=r, column=4, value=street),
            ws.cell(row=r, column=5, value=lat),
            ws.cell(row=r, column=6, value=lon),
        ]
        for cell in cells:
            dash = cell.value == "-"
            cell.font = Font(name=FONT, size=11, color="808080" if dash else "000000", italic=dash)
            cell.fill = fill
            cell.border = border
            cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center")
        for cell in cells[4:]:
            cell.number_format = "0.000000"
            cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")

        maps = ws.cell(row=r, column=7, value="Lihat Peta")
        maps.hyperlink = f"https://www.google.com/maps?q={lat},{lon}"
        maps.font = Font(name=FONT, size=11, color="0563C1", underline="single")
        maps.fill = fill
        maps.border = border
        maps.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")

        nc = ws.cell(row=r, column=8, value=note or "")
        nc.font = Font(name=FONT, size=9.5, italic=True, color="9C5700", bold=bool(note))
        nc.fill = fill
        nc.border = border
        nc.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)

    for col, w in WIDTHS.items():
        ws.column_dimensions[col].width = w
    ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
    wb.save(out_path)
    return f"Excel: {len(rows)} perangkat, {sum(1 for r in rows if r[5])} baris bercatatan"


def build_template(out_path):
    """Empty input workbook with the right headers and one example row."""
    build_xlsx([["Hub Contoh (OTB 1, PORT 1&2)", "Jl.Contoh", -6.2, 106.8,
                 "CABLE 24C/4T, TUBE: BLUE, CORE : BLUE, ORANGE", "hapus baris contoh ini"],
                ["OLT Contoh", "Jl.Contoh", -6.21, 106.81, "-", ""]], out_path)
